title.en: China’s next growth engine? An AI-powered intelligence dividend
title.zh: 中国的下一个增长引擎？人工智能驱动的智能红利。

items.source: China Economy - South China Morning Post

facts.en:
- As China enters its 15th five-year plan, policymakers face a structural constraint that cannot be eased with another round of infrastructure spending or property stimulus. The demographic dividend that powered four decades of expansion is fading. Industrial competition has intensified. The central economic question is no longer how fast China can grow, but how productively.

title.en: How bond market's private credit crisis fears are playing out in fixed-income ETFs
title.zh: 债券市场的私人信贷危机担忧如何在固定收益ETF中显现
title.es: How bond market's private credit crisis fears are playing out in fixed-income ETFs

facts.en:
- Fears of a private credit crisis arrived just as the growing and less transparent bond market was being included in more fixed-income ETFs.
- By restoring 100% bonus depreciation, the OBBBA is providing liquidity needed for economic growth.
- The Iran cease-fire may be the ‘green light’ the Fed needs.
facts.zh:
- 私人信贷危机的担忧出现时，正值不断增长且透明度较低的债券市场被纳入更多固定收益ETF。
- 通过恢复100%奖金折旧，OBBBA正在提供经济增长所需的流动性。
- 伊朗停火可能是美联储所需的“绿灯”。
facts.es:
